okcook — Privacy Policy

Applies to okcook v1.0.2 · Last updated 15 August 2026

okcook is a browser extension that turns a recipe page into ingredients, steps and a shopping list. This policy states exactly what it does with your data.

At a glance

Accounts or sign-inNone
Analytics, telemetry, crash reportingNone
Advertising, tracking, profilingNone
Third-party SDKsNone
Data sold or transferredNone
Sent to us automaticallyNothing
Sent to us on requestOnly a feedback report you write and submit

What stays on your device

Your meal plan, saved recipes, pantry items, shopping-list check-offs and display settings are stored locally through chrome.storage.local. They never leave your device, and we operate no server that holds them. Uninstalling okcook removes all of it.

Reading a recipe

When you open okcook on a recipe page, the page is read locally in your browser and nothing is transmitted.

When you paste a recipe URL into the Meal Planner, okcook fetches that page in order to extract the recipe. The request goes to the recipe website itself. We do not receive, log or store it.

Feedback you choose to send

The "Send feedback" form is the only feature that transmits anything to us, and it does so only when you press send.

you  →  Google Form  →  private response sheet

What the report contains

FieldDetail
Summary and descriptionThe text you type
Feedback type and impactThe options you select
Email addressOptional. Included only if you enter one, and used solely to reply
Extension versionFor example, 1.0.2
Browser name and versionFor example, Chrome 120
Page addressOnly when you begin from the "Report this page" link

That is the entire report. okcook attaches no identifier, and holds no account or device ID to attach. okcook does not collect your IP address. If you leave the email field blank, we have no means of identifying the sender.

How it is handled

DestinationA private response sheet, readable only by the okcook developer
ProcessorGoogle, which operates Forms and whose servers receive the submission
PublishedNo. Reports appear on no public tracker
RetentionFor as long as the response sheet exists
DeletionRequest removal of a report and we will delete it

If you never use the form, okcook transmits nothing to us.

What okcook does not do

  • Collect or transmit your browsing history
  • Read pages you have not asked it to process. The bundled content script registers a message listener and stays idle until you invoke the extension on that page
  • Sell or transfer your data to third parties
  • Use your data for advertising, credit assessment or lending, or for any purpose unrelated to the feature you invoked
  • Load or execute remote code. Every script runs from the installed package

Permissions

PermissionWhy it exists
storageKeeps your meal plan, recipe book, pantry and settings on your device
<all_urls>Recipe sites cannot be listed in advance. Used for three purposes only: reading the recipe on a page you have open when you invoke okcook, fetching a recipe page whose URL you paste into the Meal Planner, and submitting the feedback form when you press send

Children

okcook is not directed at children and does not knowingly collect data from anyone.

Changes

Material changes to this policy will be published here and reflected in the extension's store listing before they take effect.

Contact

Use the extension's built-in feedback form, or email okcook.feedback@gmail.com.
